run_reset_admin_password: run the CLI tool to reset the first admin user password and write credentials to a secure file
run_reset_admin_by_email: run the CLI tool with an email flag to reset a specific admin user password
run_reset_admin_main: run the main function to parse args and execute the async password reset workflow
run_reset_admin_run: run the async _run function to find an admin user and generate a new secure password
review_reset_admin_security: review the reset_admin module to verify credentials are written to a mode 0600 file instead of stdout
